metadata.title: Transformations every analyst should know
metadata.subtitle: Each row turns a raw column into a more interpretable one.

dataPoints.purpose: Group noisy continuous values into managerial categories
Make multiplicative changes additive; tame skew
dataPoints.example: log(revenue) so a 10× store reads as 1 unit larger, not 10

dataPoints.purpose: Put variables on a common scale to compare
dataPoints.example: ad spend (std) vs store size (std), both centered, both unit-variance
revenue per square foot — comparable across store sizes

dataPoints.purpose: Encode a business condition for filtering or grouping
Bring previous-period behavior into the current row
Smooth weekly/daily noise into a trend
